# Code of Conduct

## Our Commitment

We are committed to providing a welcoming, inclusive, and respectful environment for all community members, regardless of age, body size, disability, ethnicity, gender identity and expression, level of experience, nationality, personal appearance, race, religion, sexual identity, and sexual orientation.

## Our Standards

### ✅ We Value

- **Respectful communication** — Treat everyone with kindness and respect
- **Inclusive environment** — Welcome diverse perspectives and backgrounds
- **Constructive feedback** — Criticize ideas, not people
- **Collaboration** — Work together toward common goals
- **Professionalism** — Keep discussions focused and professional

### ❌ We Don't Tolerate

- Harassment, discrimination, or intimidation of any kind
- Offensive comments, jokes, or insults
- Trolling, spamming, or deliberate disruption
- Sexual harassment or unwelcome romantic advances
- Sharing private information without consent
- Aggressive or abusive behavior

## Where This Applies

This Code of Conduct applies to:

- GitHub issues and pull requests
- GitHub discussions
- Code comments and documentation
- Project meetings and communications
- Any official project events

## Reporting Violations

If you witness or experience a violation of this Code of Conduct:

1. **Report privately** → Email: [support@containercar.com](mailto:support@containercar.com)
2. **Provide details** → Include what happened, when, where, and any evidence
3. **Stay confidential** → We handle reports with confidentiality

**Do not** call out violations publicly unless it's to ensure immediate safety.

## Enforcement

- Minor violations → Friendly reminder or warning
- Repeated violations → Temporary or permanent suspension
- Severe violations → Immediate action
- Appeals → Handled by project maintainers

## Attribution

This Code of Conduct is adapted from the [Contributor Covenant](https://www.contributor-covenant.org/), version 2.1, available at [https://www.contributor-covenant.org/version/2/1/code_of_conduct.html](https://www.contributor-covenant.org/version/2/1/code_of_conduct.html).

**Thank you for helping us maintain a positive, inclusive community!** 🤝
